case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our long-standing relationship with your company means a great deal to our foundry and our team, but a delayed effective date of April 2027 combined with your proposed prices is not feasible for us. 

We can agree to the 24-month term and the April 2027 start date, provided the price is €51.80 with 30-day payment terms. 

To make this explicit, our offer stands at a price of €51.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised proposal and the movement it shows, which honors our long-standing partnership. In our family foundry, we take great pride in our craft, our dedicated people, and the strong ties we have built over the years with valued partners like you. 

In the spirit of reaching a mutually beneficial agreement, we are prepared to make a further concession. We can offer a price of €51.30 per unit for the 24-month contract starting in April 2027 with 30-day payment terms.

To summarize our current Angebot clearly, we present a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

For generations, our family foundry has taken deep pride in delivering quality casting to our valued partners in the region. We truly appreciate the long relationship between our companies, and our skilled craftsmen are already preparing to execute your order with the utmost care and dedication.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
